messages:
aparna: Kicking off the 09:30 deploy for routing-edge. Plan is a staggered feature-flag ramp for `enable_edge_degradation_v2` + a short 10m observation window per cohort. Will pin model-routing binary to v3.4.2 for this flight.

aparna: Ramp plan -> 0% -> 5% -> 25% -> 60% -> 100%, 10m pause between steps. If p95 latency increases >150ms over baseline OR error rate >0.8% for 2 consecutive windows, we rollback the flag.

jonathan: @aparna noted. Can you pin the canary group to eu-west-1 only for the first two steps? want to limit blast radius.

aparna: yes — cohort A (canary) = eu-west-1, cohort B = us-east-1, rest = global. I'll flip cohorts via the flag API.

deploy-bot: Deployment job started: release/routing-edge v3.4.2 -> serverset pool-12. Logs: https://deploys.internal/routing-edge/2461234567 :rocket:

hannah: Quick checklist: make sure KV cache warmup is enabled and batching is set to 64 for eu-west canary. If we see KV-miss >5% open rollback.

aparna: acknowledged. warming KV cache now. patching batching config: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.flags.internal/flags/enable_edge_degradation_v2/set 
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN' 
 -d '{"cohorts": [{"name":"canary","percent":5,"region":"eu-west-1"}]}'
```

sre-ops: @aparna heads-up: autoscaler flagged higher GPU memory pressure in eu-west during the last test. Keep an eye on OOMs; we have a pod drain playbook ready.

deploy-bot: Flag updated: `enable_edge_degradation_v2` -> cohorts applied (5% canary eu-west-1). Observing metrics for first window.

hannah: Observing p50/p95 and error-rate dashboards. p95 is +40ms so far, error-rate 0.12% — within tolerance. :eyes:

aparna: proceeding to step 25% for eu-west + us-east canary split. Will not touch rest until next window.

deploy-bot: Flag updated -> middle ramp: 25% (eu-west 15%, us-east 10%). Waiting 10 minutes.

jonathan: small note: if latency drifts but errors stay low, prefer to cap at 60% and revisit batching/quantization before full 100%.

hannah: 3m left on window. p95 trending +160ms vs baseline and tail CPU on routing-edge host is spiking. Triggering pre-set alert threshold.

sre-ops: I’m pausing the next ramp. Starting rollback to 5% for now while we triage.

aparna: rolling back cohorts -> setting to 5% global while we correlate spike with recent kernel change.

deploy-bot: Flag update: rollback applied -> `enable_edge_degradation_v2` set to 5% (stable). Telemetry link: https://metrics.internal/routing-edge?run=2461234567

hannah: Postmortem action items in brief: 1) tighten CPU tail alert thresholds for routing-edge, 2) disable new kernel opt on eu-west staging until validated, 3) add KV warmup telemetry.

jonathan: +1 on kernel opt. Also recommend adding an automatic holdpoint at 50% if p95 >120ms for consecutive windows.

aparna: Thanks all. I'm creating a release note snippet and will tag infra and release managers. We'll reattempt after kernel revert. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Deployment job completed with status: partial (ramped then rolled back to 5%). See release notes draft: https://releases.internal/2461234567/draft

sre-ops: Moving to incident channel for triage; will post summary here when we have timeline.
